name: writing-local-editor
description: Bragi: a ledger of an author's decisions, a reader (CLI and MCP) for agents, and a local editor. Only a person turns a judgement into a rule.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wle/core && npm run typecheck -w @wle/editor && npm run typecheck -w @wle/mcp
scripts.test: npm test -w @wle/core && npm test -w @wle/editor && npm test -w @wle/mcp
